root_idea.summary: The root centers on the solidification or congealing of something fluid, especially through cold or loss of liquidity.
root_idea.development: From this core, the lexicon extends to fixedness and motionlessness, dry or barren conditions, stagnation, lifelessness, withholding, and related figurative and technical uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized masculine active-participle citation form rather than the Quranic feminine inflection.

senses.definition: Remaining fixed or motionless; apparently stationary.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction describing the mountains, it denotes their appearing fixed or motionless even as the passage describes their movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To congeal, freeze, or become solid; of a liquid, blood, or similar substance, to lose its fluidity or become dry.
To become incapable of growth or increase; to become lifeless or dead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from loss of growth or vitality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dull, stupid, inert, ineffective, or lacking in strength and endurance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage applied to a person or to performance and capability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stagnant or unimproving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person's state or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to have little milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage describing reduced milk production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eye, to shed few tears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may allude to hardness of heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become niggardly, penurious, or withholding; to possess little good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a hand or palm that withholds what should be given.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a right or due to become incumbent or established against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction جَمَدَ لِي عَلَيْهِ حَقِّي and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut something or cut it off.
To be on the point of congealing, becoming solid, or freezing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes water or expressed juice approaching solidification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause water or another liquid to congeal or become solid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative usage associated with the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be entrusted with the management of affairs in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage concerning the administration of the game and its participants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a right or due incumbent or established against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Congealed or frozen water; ice, and also snow.
An elevated, hard, or rugged tract of ground; especially a small isolated hill or mountain, sometimes producing herbs or trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical noun distinguished from جُمُودٌ by the type of terrain described.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone.
An inanimate thing without a soul; something incapable of growth or increase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantively or adjectivally for inorganic things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry, sterile, barren, or unproductive land on which rain has not fallen or in which there is no produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the absence of fluidity or growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year lacking rain, herbage, pasture, produce, or abundance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a year characterized by drought or unfruitfulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female camel, ewe, or she-goat having no or little milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passage also reports a gloss meaning slow, but identifies that reading as probably a transcription error for the low-milk sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of cloth or garment.
In the imprecation جَمَادِ لَهُ, a wish that a miser remain in a stagnant or unimproving condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression used reproachfully of a niggard; a contrasting laudatory use is also reported, though its transmitted form is unclear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Elevated tracts softer or more level than جُمُدٌ and intermixed with softer or level ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized topographical noun, distinct from the related term for a harder isolated elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Either of the two Arabian months called Jumādā: Jumādā al-Awwal or Jumādā al-Ākhirah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The month-name is feminine and determinate; the plural is جُمَادَيَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wintry, as in a wintry night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally in the expression لَيْلَةٌ جُمَادِيَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword, especially one that makes a person struck by it motionless; also a sharp, cutting sword.
Solid, congealed, or frozen, especially of water or another liquid; also hard, as a piece of marrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The physical sense is distinct from the Quranic usage of the related active participle for apparent motionlessness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inanimate, lifeless, or incapable of growth or increase; a solid or inorganic thing opposed to what is living, growing, or fluid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe the inanimate portion of property, such as gold, silver, stones, or other solid things, in contrast with livestock, trees, or fluids.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicology and grammar, non-derived or non-infinitival; also applied to a verb restricted to one tense and lacking a verbal noun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term opposed to a derived or fully inflected form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dull, stupid, inert, ineffective, soft, or lacking vigor, sturdiness, and endurance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival usage applied to a person or his capacities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stagnant or unimproving in condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's state or circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eye, shedding no tears or few tears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the expression جَامِدُ العَيْنِ for a person whose eye does not readily weep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardly, penurious, or avaricious; withholding what one is obliged to give.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a person possessing little or no good.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Limits, boundaries, or boundary-marks between lands or dwellings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person entrusted with managing or administering the arrows and affairs of the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of a nonparticipant who shuffles or deals the arrows and may enforce an incurred obligation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who takes or holds with both hands so that nothing leaves them; one tenacious of what is in his possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of the poetic usage of مُجْمِدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person entering upon the month of Jumādā.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation connected with the month’s traditional association with cold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose arrow wins or gains nothing in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized interpretation of the term in the context of the game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which ice is kept.
A neighbor whose house or tent adjoins one’s own.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression هُوَ مُجَامِدِي.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The fixed or stationary sense is covered by the Quran-attested sense.
Plural or quasi-plural grammatical identification and pointer.
Lifeless or dead is stated within the broader inanimate/lifeless meaning.
Several reported lexical interpretations are retained as distinct branches.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the feminine form جَامِدَةً; the public headword is normalized to the masculine active-participle citation form جَامِدٌ.
The Quranic stationary sense is kept distinct from the broader physical sense of being solid or congealed.
The Lane Quran reference associated with the stationary sense is preserved through its lexical source; the modern example location used here is the independently supplied QAC location 27:88.
The مُجْمِدٌ entry preserves several reported interpretations because the evidence does not reduce them confidently to one meaning.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The transmitted discussion of the contrasting laudatory use associated with جَمَادِ لَهُ in lane:entry:47294 is internally unclear; the clear imprecation meaning is represented, while the exact contrasting form is not normalized.
